symptom: `create external entities from M.Client into M` names a top-level entity after the OData entity SET (`ModA.Parts`) where Studio Pro names it after the entity TYPE (`ModA.Part`); a later script using `ModA.Part` fails with "entity does not exist"
cause: `createExternalEntities` chose `entitySet.Name` for every top-level entity, and the navigation-association and primitive-collection passes re-derived the same name to find their ends. `describe contract entity … format mdl` already emitted the type name, so mxcli disagreed with itself as well as with Studio Pro
insight: **The evidence for Studio Pro's naming was already in the repo**: the TripPin measurement tables in cmd_contract.go and the complex-type tests list `Person (entity set People)` — a Studio Pro-generated entity named after the type. Grep the measured tables before asking for a Studio Pro reference. **A rename of what an import produces is a re-import hazard, not just a cosmetic fix**: matching the existing entity by the NEW name makes every project imported by an older mxcli grow a type-named twin mapping the same entity set, and mx check does not complain (both entities are valid). So the upsert resolves by remote identity first (Source=Rest$ODataRemoteEntitySource + RemoteServiceName + RemoteEntitySet, all read back by the modelsdk reader) and keeps the old name, which pages and microflows already use. Name resolution happened in THREE passes; changing only the first leaves the association pass looking up the old name and silently creating no associations — a test that asserts the association exists catches it. Test fixtures need nav-property names that do not collide with entity names, or uniqueAssocName suffixes them (`Supplier_2`) and the assertion fails for an unrelated reason. Measured on 11.12.1: base build reproduces `external entity not found: Issue1432.Product`; fixed build creates Product/Category, mx check 0 errors; a project imported by the base build and re-imported by the fixed one reports `0 created, 2 updated` and keeps Products/Categories. Tests `cmd_contract_entity_name_test.go`; repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1432-external-entities-named-after-entity-type.mdl`
